connector.name: MCP by dungbeetle.dev
connector.registryDescription: Visual regression & snapshot testing for AI agents - list runs, read semantic diffs, review.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dungbeetle-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.dungbeetle, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: DUNGBEETLE_AGENT_TOKEN
env.description: Scoped, revocable agent token minted via `dungbeetle login` (recommended).

env.name: DUNGBEETLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Repository client id (CI-style alternative to an agent token).

env.name: DUNGBEETLE_SERVER_URL
env.description: Server origin; only needed when self-hosting (default https://dungbeetle.dev).
